benefit_axis_note: The only support instrument in the act, and it is optional for the Member State. Recorded as an incentive whose existence is conditional rather than left out because it is conditional.

opportunity_basis.text: the introduction of financial incentives, such as discounts, monetary rewards or deposit-refund systems

duty: Put quantities and concentrations, an assessment of technical and economic recoverability, and the estimation methods used into the study.
addressee: Operators of extractive waste facilities
trigger: the Art. 27(1) study
source_text: The study referred to in paragraph 1 shall at least include an estimation of the quantities and concentrations of critical raw materials contained in the extractive waste and in the extracted volume and an assessment of their technical and economic recoverability. Operators shall specify the methods used to estimate those quantities and concentrations.
benefit_axis_note: The content specification is what makes the study expensive, and it is separately stated from the duty to produce one.

duty: Cooperate with the Member State's sampling and characterisation of closed extractive waste facilities where national property, mineral or environmental law prevents the authority acting alone.
addressee: Operators and owners of closed extractive waste facilities
trigger: national legal constraints on the Member State's Art. 27(7) activities
source_text: Where such factors inhibit the activities, the Member State authorities shall seek the cooperation of the operator or owner of the extractive waste facility.
benefit_axis_note: A duty that lands on a former operator of a CLOSED facility -- a party that may have no other obligation under the act at all.

duty: Give magnet information at electric-motor level where the magnets sit only in motors, and put the information in the product passport where another Union act requires one.
addressee: Anyone placing listed products containing permanent magnets on the market
trigger: magnets contained exclusively in electric motors, or a product passport required by another act
source_text: For products where the incorporated permanent magnets are exclusively contained in one or more electric motors incorporated in the product, the information referred to in paragraph 4, point (b), may be replaced by information on the location of those electric motors, and the information referred to in paragraph 4, point (c), may be replaced by information on the access and removal of the electric motors, at least including the sequence of all removal steps, tools or technologies required for the access and removal of the electric motors. 6. For products referred to in paragraph 3 for which a product passport is required pursuant to another Union legal act, the information referred to in paragraph 4 shall be included in that product passport.
benefit_axis_note: Two simplifications inside the magnet regime: a coarser disclosure where the magnets are all in motors, and one passport instead of two. The register carries the burden and not the relief.

benefit: Non-compliant products and materials may still be shown at trade fairs and demonstrations, provided a visible sign says they are non-compliant and cannot be marketed until they are.
addressee: Exhibitors of products incorporating permanent magnets and of critical raw materials
trigger: a trade fair, exhibition, demonstration or similar event
source_text: At trade fairs, exhibitions, demonstrations or similar events, Member States shall not prevent the showing of products incorporating permanent magnets or of critical raw materials which do not comply with this Regulation

right_basis.text: Member States shall not prevent the showing of products incorporating permanent magnets or of critical raw materials which do not comply with this Regulation, provided that a visible sign clearly indicates that such products or critical raw materials do not comply

duty: Have an economic operator established in the Union responsible for the product under Art. 4 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 before placing it on the market.
addressee: Manufacturers, importers and authorised representatives of products covered by this Regulation
trigger: a product subject to Regulation (EU) 2024/1252 placed on the Union market
source_text: This Article applies only in relation to products that are subject to Regulations (EU) No 305/2011
benefit_axis_note: Art. 43 adds this Regulation to the list in Art. 4(5) of the market surveillance Regulation, which is the provision requiring a responsible economic operator ESTABLISHED IN THE UNION. Pass A read Arts. 40-43 as procedural amendments; this one creates an establishment requirement for every covered product.

duty: Supply information beyond what the reporting provisions listed in Art. 45(1) already require.
addressee: Economic operators along the critical raw materials value chain
trigger: a Member State compiling its annual report to the Commission
source_text: Economic operators shall not be required to submit information in addition to the information provided in the context of the provisions listed in the first subparagraph.
benefit_axis_note: A ceiling on what may be asked of operators when a Member State assembles its report. Real relief, stated once, and the register has nothing on it.
